faqs.q: What is the maximum PDF size for email?
faqs.a: Gmail and Yahoo limit attachments to 25MB, while Outlook limits them to 20MB. Our tool reduces your PDF to safely fit under these limits.

faqs.q: Will compression ruin my document?
faqs.a: No. We use intelligent downscaling that optimizes images and removes invisible metadata while keeping all text perfectly crisp and readable.

faqs.q: How do I compress a PDF to under 100KB?

faqs.q: Are my sensitive documents stored?
faqs.a: Never. EasyPDFTools processes everything in memory and automatically drops the file the moment your download begins.

faqs.q: What if my invoice is a scanned image?

faqs.q: Is there a limit to how many statements I can merge?

faqs.q: Will the merged file be huge?

faqs.q: How do I extract just one page?

faqs.q: Will extracting a page reduce the quality?
faqs.a: No. The page is extracted identically to the original without any recompression or quality loss.

title: Split PDF into Chapters

faqs.q: How do I split a book into multiple chapters?
faqs.a: Use comma-separated ranges. For example, typing '1-15, 16-40, 41-100' will give you three separate PDF files for those exact chapter ranges.

faqs.q: How do I receive the split files?
faqs.a: The chapters are instantly packaged into a single ZIP file so you can download them all at once.

title: Sign NDA PDF Online
meta_description: Draw your signature and instantly stamp it onto a Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA) entirely in your browser.

faqs.q: Is my confidential NDA uploaded to your servers?
faqs.a: No. Our signature tool runs 100% locally in your web browser. The NDA never leaves your computer.

faqs.q: Are these legally binding signatures?
faqs.a: This tool applies a standard electronic image stamp of your signature, which is widely accepted for standard NDAs and contracts, but it is not a cryptographically certified digital signature.
